name: Forest Fires Dataset
description: The Forest Fires dataset is a classic environmental regression benchmark curated by Paulo Cortez and Aníbal Morais (EPIA 2007) and deposited in the UCI Machine Learning Repository (DOI: 10.24432/C5D88D). The dataset compiles 517 wildfire events from the Montesinho Natural Park in the Trás-os-Montes region of northeast Portugal (2000–2003) to predict burned area using meteorological attributes and Fire Weather Index (FWI) components. Features include spatial coordinates (X, Y), month, day of week, Fine Fuel Moisture Code (FFMC), Duff Moisture Code (DMC), Drought Code (DC), Initial Spread Index (ISI), temperature, relative humidity, wind speed, and rain.
